feature: Hostile rejection-reason recovery in Editor diagnostics
defect: Both the standalone boot handler and the initialized diagnostics handler used implicit string coercion for untrusted rejection values. A value with a throwing Symbol.toPrimitive could throw in the event listeners, while the boot handler also duplicated events after the main diagnostics owner had initialized.

implementation.diagnostics_normalization: Reads untrusted error fields defensively, catches failing string coercion, and uses a safe generic fallback without retaining Error objects.
implementation.boot_listener_ownership: Boot-only listeners run only before the diagnostics module is available; initialized runtime errors are recorded by one diagnostics owner.
implementation.redaction: The preboot rejection fallback redacts bearer credentials, token-like values, URL query secrets, email, phone, and control characters.
implementation.invariants: No change to document state, Save, Publish, API, D1 or R2.
